description: Header file defining the RenderMain class responsible for rendering Direct2D and 3D content in a Windows app using XAML and Direct3D 11. It includes properties and methods for managing rendering, device notifications, user interactions, and tracing features.

classes.name: RenderMain
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IDeviceNotify, responsible for rendering graphics content, handling device events, user input, and tracing functionalities in a Windows app using DirectX and XAML.

methods.name: RenderMain
methods.description: Constructor initializing RenderMain with a SwapChainPanel.

methods.name: CreateWindowSizeDependentResources
methods.description: Creates resources dependent on window size.

methods.name: CanRenderPoint
methods.description: Checks if a point can be rendered.

methods.name: SetPointRadius
methods.description: Sets the radius for point rendering.

methods.name: RunRenderPassAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously performs a rendering pass, allowing cancellation.

methods.name: GetRenderError
methods.description: Returns the HRESULT error code from rendering.

methods.name: ActiveTracing
methods.description: Property indicating if active tracing mode is enabled.

methods.name: ActiveTraceCursorPosition
methods.description: Gets or sets the cursor position for active tracing.

methods.name: XTraceValue
methods.description: Gets the current X trace value.

methods.name: YTraceValue
methods.description: Gets the current Y trace value.

methods.name: TraceLocation
methods.description: Gets the current trace location on screen.

methods.name: Tracing
methods.description: Indicates if tracing popup is shown.
